description: This file contains the implementation of the DynamoDBReminderTable class, which manages reminder entries in DynamoDB for Orleans. It includes methods for initializing the table, reading, writing, and deleting reminder entries, and handles DynamoDB-specific operations and logging.

classes.name: DynamoDBReminderTable
classes.description: Implements IReminderTable using DynamoDB as storage backend, providing methods for managing reminder entries including initialization, reading, upserting, and removal.

methods.name: DynamoDBReminderTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DynamoDBReminderTable with logger, cluster options, and storage options.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB table with specified schema and secondary indexes.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry for a given grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries for a given grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a specified hash range.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a DynamoDB item dictionary into a ReminderEntry object.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder entry for a given grain ID, reminder name, and eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears all reminder entries from the table, used for testing.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in DynamoDB, returning the new eTag.

methods.name: ConstructReminderId
methods.description: Constructs a unique reminder ID string from service ID, grain ID, and reminder name.

methods.name: LogInformationInitializingDynamoDBRemindersTable
methods.description: Logs the initialization of DynamoDB reminders table.

methods.name: LogWarningReadReminderEntry
methods.description: Logs a warning when reading a reminder entry fails.

methods.name: LogWarningReadReminderEntries
methods.description: Logs a warning when reading multiple reminder entries fails.

methods.name: LogWarningReadReminderEntryRange
methods.description: Logs a warning when reading a range of reminder entries fails.

methods.name: LogWarningRemoveReminderEntries
methods.description: Logs a warning when removing reminder entries fails.

methods.name: LogDebugUpsertRow
methods.description: Logs debug information for upserting a reminder entry.

methods.name: LogWarningUpdateReminderEntry
methods.description: Logs a warning when updating a reminder entry fails.
